(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more polyisocyanates modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two distinct OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one polyisocyanate modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid based on an aliphatic diisocyanate.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The dispersion of claim 3, wherein the aliphatic diisocyanate is 1,6-diisocyanatohexane.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: A method of producing a cleanable coating on a substrate comprising applying the dispersion of claim 1 to the substrate and curing the coating composition.

(Original) Claim 6: A coating produced according to the method of claim 5.

(Original) Claim 7: The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating is greater than 31.0 dynes/cm.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The coating of claim 7, wherein the surface roughness of the coating, measured in root mean square roughness, is greater than 200 nm.
